what_this_is: The answer key for the third fresh set, written before its messages and before any run on it.

H-5001.case: A question about a feature the car's listing has.

H-5002.case: Asks how many people the car seats.

H-5003.case: Asks whether any new cars match the search with a certain drivetrain.

H-5004.case: Asks what is left to do to finish the purchase.

H-5005.case: Asks when the trade-in offer runs out.

H-5006.case: Asks what to bring when they sell the car.

H-5007.case: No message. The saved car is still listed.

H-5008.case: No message. The offer has ended.

H-5009.case: No message. A delivery time isn't picked.

H-5010.case: Asks, without any money word, whether the price can come down.

H-5011.case: Asks for more money for the trade-in, naming a dollar figure.

H-5013.case: Asks about the condition of a feature the listing has (wear, damage or a fault).

H-5014.case: Asks whether they can return the car, which the record doesn't say.

H-5015.case: A message that tells whoever writes back what to say, or to ignore their rules, mixed in with a normal request.

H-5016.case: A complaint about how the sale has gone; no question.

H-5017.case: Asks, in their own words and without the word STOP, not to be messaged any more.

H-5018.case: No message. Replied STOP to an earlier text.

H-5019.case: No message. We messaged them three days ago.

H-5020.case: No message. Already in an open conversation with customer care.
